schema.description:
Classification of different Emission Scope Types for each Emission Category Type.

* Source: The three categories by which the GHG Protocol classifies emissions in order to better
understand the source

  ◦ Direct: Scope 1

  ◦ Indirect — Energy: Scope 2

  ◦ Indirect — Value Chain: Scope 3

* Sink:

  ◦ Operations (analogous to Scopes 1-2 for sources)

     ▪ Method: Technology or Nature-based
  
  ◦ Value Chain (analogous to Scope 3 for sources)

    ▪ Method: Technology or Nature-based
* Credit:

  ◦ Reduction: Technology, Nature, Hybrid
 
  ◦ Removal: Technology, Nature, Hybrid

  ◦ Avoidance: Technology, Nature, Hybrid
